name: Preview conversion failure is visible and recoverable

planSteps.description: In an isolated run where preview conversion is configured to fail once, upload a valid small MP4 video.
Verify the page shows Preview could not be prepared, explains the source is preserved, and exposes Choose another video.
Verify no playable preview or traffic-analysis result is shown for the failed conversion.
Choose the same valid MP4 again and upload it after conversion is available.
Verify the new upload reaches Preview ready and says analysis has not started.
